external_owner_reviews.review: GraphicsJNI::setJavaVM belongs to register_android_graphics_classes outer entry. U8 startReg sets AndroidRuntime VM, a distinct owner; individual whole-function proxies do not call that outer entry. Other hidden initialization paths and app-specific first-fatal causality are not proven.

U8 runtime registration already fills runtime mObject. libandroid exports a distinct gAssetManagerOffsets and AAssetManager_fromJava. Cache addresses and ownership are distinct; registration of one does not initialize the other. Actual interposition/provider selection and glmark2 inlined path remain unresolved.

Original native/android/hardware_buffer_jni.cpp converter needs HardwareBuffer JNI cache. Registration is outside the 95-entry dispatch; public converter absent in three audited providers. Namespaced HWUI helper is not public C ABI. Other providers/registration paths remain unknown.

AOSP init_android_graphics calls SkGraphics::Init outside individual register functions. U8 individual proxy loop is not proof that OH Skia lacks initialization: initialization in another module/lazy path has not been excluded. Do not attach dumpMemoryStatistics crash to this difference without a call/context proof.
